parse.title: Debut
parse.text:
Debut
Quest data
LocationWoods, Ground Zero, Interchange, Customs
Given byPrapor

Debut is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

Contents

  • 1 Dialogue
  • 2 Requirements
  • 3 Objectives
  • 4 Rewards
  • 5 Guide

Dialogue[]

Hello there, soldier. I got a job that's a little too easy for my guys. But you'll do fine. Hey, don't get pissy, I don't know you that well yet to give you a normal job! The streets are crawling with lowlife bandits. They don't bother me much, but they're still a nuisance all the same. Calm down, say, five of them. I think that'll be enough for you. Dismissed, soldier!

Requirements[]

  • Must reach Loyalty Level 1 with Prapor to obtain this quest.

Objectives[]

  • Eliminate 5 Scavs on Woods, Ground Zero, Interchange, or Customs

Rewards[]

  • +3,000 EXP
  • Prapor Rep +0.1
  • 80,000 Roubles
    • 84,000 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 1
    • 92,000 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 2

So, you got it done. Can't say I'm surprised, but it's always worth making sure!

Guide[]

In this quest you have to kill 5 Scavs on Woods, Ground Zero, Interchange or Customs.
